title: Rachuj kolego… (PKF 9A/64) / Count, comrade…
license: WFDiF, all rights reserved (FINA Regulamin: "Wszelkie kopiowanie materiałów jest zabronione")
notes: Polska Kronika Filmowa 9A/1964, Polish narration over the whole history of counting: pebbles in sand, an abacus, a Triumphator arithmometer, an electric calculator, a rocket launch, a satellite, then the Soviet Ural 2 at the PAN Computing Centre and women at calculating machines in Łódź. PL, Polish.
